title: User-friendly social media app with automatic sign-up and posts/videos feed

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity authentication with an automatic sign-up flow: when a new principal first signs in, create a user profile automatically with sensible defaults (e.g., handle derived from principal, display name empty) and do not show a separate signup form.

quotes: Create social media app that user friendly and every can upload anything like videos posts it could be sign up system sign up system is auto

acceptanceCriteria: A user can sign in using Internet Identity.
On first successful sign-in, the backend creates a user record for the principal without requiring any extra user input.
On subsequent sign-ins, the existing user record is reused.
The UI does not include a standalone signup/registration form.

requirements.text: Create backend data models and APIs to support a social media feed with user-generated content, including: user profile records, post records (text caption + timestamps + author), and optional attached media (image/video) stored on the canister within defined size limits.

quotes: every can upload anything like videos posts

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to create a post, list posts (newest first), and fetch a single post by id.
Each post includes: id, author principal, createdAt, caption text, and optional media metadata (type, filename, byte size).
Backend persists posts and user profiles across canister upgrades using stable storage patterns (do not introduce additional actors).
Backend enforces upload limits (max size and allowed MIME types) and returns clear errors when exceeded.

requirements.text: Build a content creation UI that lets a signed-in user create a new post with caption text and optionally upload one media file (image or video) using a simple, guided form.

quotes: every can upload anything like videos posts

acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in user can open a “Create Post” view and submit caption-only posts.
A signed-in user can attach a single media file and submit it with the post.
The UI shows client-side validation (e.g., file type/size) before upload and displays server errors if returned.
After successful post creation, the user is returned to the feed and sees the new post.

requirements.text: Build a user-friendly feed/browsing experience that displays posts from all users, including caption, author, timestamp, and inline rendering of attached media (images shown as images; videos playable with standard controls).

quotes: Create social media app that user friendly

acceptanceCriteria: The home/feed view loads posts from the backend and renders them in reverse chronological order.
Posts with images render a responsive image preview.
Posts with videos render an HTML5 video player with play/pause controls.
Loading, empty-state, and error states are present and readable in English.

requirements.text: Add basic profile viewing/editing for the signed-in user: display principal-based identity, allow setting a display name and bio, and show a simple list/count of the user’s posts.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in user can view their profile information.
A signed-in user can update display name and bio, and changes persist after refresh/sign-out/sign-in.
Profile view shows the user’s posts (or a filtered list) and a post count.

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, distinct visual theme and layout for a modern, user-friendly social app UI (consistent typography, spacing, and components). Use a warm neutral palette (avoid blue/purple) and keep the experience simple and accessible.
acceptanceCriteria: App uses a consistent warm neutral color palette (e.g., off-white, charcoal, coral/amber accents) and consistent typography across pages.
Navigation between Feed, Create Post, and Profile is obvious and consistent.
All user-facing text is in English and components have clear focus/hover states.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in the main actor file).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not add third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity is allowed.
Do not rely on external databases or external object/video storage; store data within the canister and enforce practical upload size limits.
nonGoals: Real-time chat, DMs, comments, likes, follows, or notifications.
External video hosting/streaming integrations or CDN storage.
Advanced content moderation, reporting workflows, or admin dashboards.

required: Minimalist app logo mark, rounded shape, warm neutral tones (logo-mark.dim_512x512.png)
Simple empty-state illustration of a phone/feed with abstract shapes, warm neutral palette (empty-feed-illustration.dim_1200x600.png)

goalsToAdd: Build a user-friendly social media app where users can automatically sign up via Internet Identity and upload/browse posts including videos.
preferencesToAdd: Use English for all user-facing text.
Prefer a warm neutral UI theme (avoid blue/purple).
